resources.string: Choose a server, then tap Connect.
No free servers are available in this version.
Premium servers are not available in this version. Contact support for availability.
The VPN continues in the background. Use Disconnect here or in the VPN notification to stop it.
The VPN attempts to reconnect after a drop. While disconnected or reconnecting, browsing may use your normal connection. Other apps use their normal connection.
Connect BharatX Browser through a VPN?

BharatX will send this browser’s network traffic, including website requests and DNS lookups, through the selected server: %1$s. The VPN encrypts traffic between your device and that server. The server operator receives your IP address and can observe connection destinations and traffic that is not protected by HTTPS. Provider login details, when required, are sent to that provider to authenticate. This integration does not upload browsing logs to Nitaistudio. The VPN can continue in the background until you disconnect. Other apps are excluded. Connecting may replace another active VPN. Server availability and privacy practices depend on its operator. Android will ask for VPN permission.
Use credentials issued by this VPN provider. Access is verified by the server. The browser does not save them in preferences.
The server needs valid provider credentials. Check your login or choose another server.
VPN permission was denied or revoked. Tap Connect to request it again.
The VPN engine is unavailable in this installation. Contact support.

Could not connect. Check your network, retry, or choose another server.
